MANOSABALIN_SETTINGS.title: ManosabaLin
Replaces the game's main menu with a random ManosabaLin static background.
When enabled, one of three static backgrounds will be randomly selected each time the main menu is opened.
MANOSABALIN_SETTINGS.events.section.desc: Choose which ManosabaLin events can appear in a match.
MANOSABALIN_SETTINGS.events.kinmaneyurak: Allow "Magical Girl's Witch Judge" × "Karako" to appear
MANOSABALIN_SETTINGS.events.multiplayerC: Allow "Magical Girl No Witch Judge" x Nora to appear
MANOSABALIN_SETTINGS.events.teamCardExch: Allows "Magical Girl No Witch Judge" × "Arikana" to appear.
